title: Pheromone Trails
summary: Ant stigmergy: agents never message each other. As each agent works it leaves marks (pheromone) in a shared field, such as "this path worked", with a strength. Others follow stronger marks more often. Marks fade over time, so unused paths disappear and good paths grow stronger. This is how ant colony optimisation finds short routes.
whenToUse: Huge numbers of cheap agents searching a space: routes, test cases, configurations, game paths.
strengths: No messages, so it scales to thousands
risks: Can settle on a good trail that is not the best
Slow to start until trails form

smileMetrics.cooperation: Trips that strengthened a trail others then used.
smileMetrics.harmony: Share of traffic on the best trail.
smileMetrics.gathering: Trips until the best trail carries most traffic.

communication: Agents send each other nothing. Ants read and write the field; the Evaporator fades it each round. The Colony reads the field every N rounds and reports the strongest trail.
cooperation: Cooperation = trips that strengthened a trail others then used ÷ trips.

roles.name: Colony
Ant
roles.prompt:
(; Write many, deterministic or tier 1. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🐜👣 ***Ant [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You make one trip from [$Nest$] toward [$Goal$]. ) :)
(: Listen ( Mark strengths on the paths you can see. ) :)
[= Choose paths with probability by strength, plus a little randomness. On return, mark your path by its quality. =]
[: Response Format (
🐜👣 ***Ant [$n$]***:
# Trip
{paths taken}
# Mark
{strength added}
) :]

roles.name: Evaporator
roles.prompt:
(; Write one, deterministic. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🌬️🧪 ***Evaporator***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You fade every mark each round. ) :)
(: Listen ( The field. ) :)
[= Multiply every mark by [$1 minus rate$]. Change nothing else. =]
[: Response Format (
🌬️🧪 ***Evaporator***:
# Field
{mark strengths after fading}
) :]

roles.name: Pheromone field
roles.prompt:
(; Minimal sub-prompt generated for a role the diagram gives no sub-prompt. ;)
✨🙂 ***Pheromone field [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You are Pheromone field. ) :)
(: Listen ( Your permitted neighbours only. ) :)
[= Reply with the name tag and the response format. =]
[: Response Format (
✨🙂 ***Pheromone field [$n$]***:
# Done
{what was done}
# Blocked
{the blocker, or "none"}
) :]
